company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'VANCOUVER, British Columbia, June 03, 2024 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Solstice Gold Corp. (TSXV: SGC) (“Solstice”, “we”, “our” or the “Company”)...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The text states: 'Pablo McDonald, Solstice CEO stated, “Over the course of the last several months our technical team’s diligent work led us to acquire this highly prospective land package in the Abitibi Subprovince.”'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company entered into an option agreement 'to purchase the Option to acquire the Optionors’ 100% interest in the Strathy Gold Project.'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the 'Strathy Gold Project'.

currency.justification: The payments are denominated in '$' and the acquiring company, Solstice Gold Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian exchange, implying the currency is Canadian Dollars.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of an initial $20,000 payment, a $25,000 payment on the first anniversary, a $25,000 payment on the second anniversary, and a $35,000 payment on the third anniversary. 'Solstice must pay $20,000 in cash... a payment of $25,000 cash by the first anniversary... a payment of $25,000 cash by the second anniversary... a payment of $35,000 cash by the third anniversary.'
